title: LSF/LSP to LPC Conversion
text: Convert line spectral frequencies or line spectral pairs to linear prediction coefficients, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Input} sets Line spectral pairs or line spectral frequencies LSP in range.

ports.name: LSFn
ports.summary: Line spectral frequencies normalized in range (0 0.5) vector | matrix

ports.name: LSFr
ports.summary: Line spectral frequencies in range (0 π) vector | matrix

params.name: Input
params.values: Line spectral pairs or line spectral frequencies LSP in range (-1 1) (default) | LSF normalized in range (0 0.5) | LSF in range (0 pi)
